data.body:
FINAL rebar-debug report

Problem: one macOS editor-server fixture intermittently consumed 35 seconds, extending the Gerrit Verify critical path.

Proven root cause: Python HTTPServer.server_bind performs socket.getfqdn(host) to populate server_name. Organic run 31846417650 observed socket.getfqdn=35.013s, server constructor=35.014s, and _server fixture=35.020s while TCP bind was under 1s. The nested timings were equal, proving reverse DNS—not bind, test body, queueing, Pandoc, or mutation—was the operation. The changeable artifact was editor.py constructing the stock ThreadingHTTPServer.

Proof: targeted instrumentation timed constructor, TCPServer.server_bind, and socket.getfqdn independently. It observed the 35.013s call at runtime. Post-fix organic patch-set run 31850293962 contains zero socket.getfqdn timing events; the macOS job passed, default suite=24m26s and integration=2m41s. The fix removed this specific long pole, although overall workflow wall remained 34m31, so remaining suite/setup work is tracked separately rather than misattributed.

Test: tests/unit/workflow/test_editor.py::test_server_starts_and_serves_without_reverse_dns starts the real loopback server with socket.getfqdn defect-injected to raise, then fetches the real workflow endpoint and asserts content. It was RED against stock ThreadingHTTPServer, GREEN with the fix, and returned to RED when the stock constructor was restored. The timing-instrumentation test was also retargeted after LLM review correctly found that patching http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer no longer intercepted the imported subclass.

Fix: editor_server.py adds _LoopbackThreadingHTTPServer.server_bind, delegates the actual bind to TCPServer.server_bind, and records the literal bound host/port without reverse DNS. editor.py uses that subclass. No dependency was added and no test was weakened.

Scope/safety: the caller sweep found one constructor site, the local loopback editor. Exact host/port and live serving behavior are preserved. The security contract remains loopback-only. This restores prompt startup rather than creating capability.

Siblings/parity: a repository sweep found no other live HTTPServer constructor. CLI/MCP/library parity is N/A because this is the editor launcher’s single shared server core.

Residual risk: run 31850293962 still took 34m31 end-to-end; accepted as a separate, measured fixture/suite-runtime problem under inedible-subsimious-brahmancow and unbrowned-senatorial-guppy, not residual DNS uncertainty.

Replication: Gerrit 1795 patch set 2 earned LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and merged as 32eee274c71030082656fa377161c1dc42be363c. CI_RESULT: {"run_id":"31850293962","status":"passed","duration":2071,"fixes_applied":["bypass reverse DNS in the loopback editor server"],"retry_count":0}.
